root_cause.text: The drm_buddy_alloc_blocks function fails to validate that the size after rounding (via roundup_pow_of_two for contiguous allocations or round_up for non-contiguous) does not exceed mm->size, causing the computed order to exceed mm->max_order and triggering a BUG_ON.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a check `if (order > mm->max_order || size > mm->size)` immediately after size rounding, and either returns -EINVAL or falls back to __alloc_contig_try_harder instead of allowing BUG_ON. The CVE description confirms that rounding 9G to 16G on 10G VRAM causes BUG_ON(order > mm->max_order).
